title: Welcome
text: This little game shows the tutorial module: bubbles, veil, filtered actions and interludes.
notes: The Buy button is hidden during this lesson

title: Your gold
text: This is your gold. You use it to buy items.
Click Harvest to earn a coin.
notes: Only the harvest action is allowed

title: Well done!
text: You have 3 coins. The Buy button appears.

title: Free play
text: Buy a sword. You start with 1 coin: if you are short, a hint will show up.

notes: No veil and no restriction: the player plays freely

title: Sword bought!
text: That's it. Pick a lesson from the list to start again.

title: Not enough gold
text: You need 3 coins: harvest a little more.
notes: Interlude played by the not_enough_gold hint
